prompts.past_1519: Aerial drone footage flying slowly over Tenochtitlan in 1519, the Aztec capital built on a lake. In the distance a great stepped pyramid with twin temples rises over the city. Soft morning light, light haze over the lake, documentary cinematography, realistic, highly detailed.
